title: Disposable battery proves routes and rejects malformed or wrong-content artifacts
scenarios: Run the default fixture battery with a temporary profile and workspace; identify its result as synthetic fixture evidence.
Reject nonempty corrupt PDF and PPTX files, valid-format wrong-content artifacts, malformed slide XML, and broken slide relationships.
Reject a valid spreadsheet whose formula result is wrong; accept known-correct PDF, PPTX, and XLSX read-backs.
Bound Control Plane HTTP-over-WebSocket requests and artifact parsing by deadlines.
Cancel timed-out owned workers, stop detached process trees, and retain the temporary profile when cleanup is unresolved.
Stop by default on approvals; allow only explicit types scoped to the exact owned task and workspace resource.

Require live browser, web-search, and run-command evidence from a tool call paired to its successful result by toolUseId; reject wrong, missing, failed, or contradictory canonical timeline events and require browser/command artifacts to match the paired result.
Reject XLSX ZIP bombs, false expanded lengths, and CRC mismatches before ExcelJS reads any package entry.

Fail full live mode before profile creation unless the grader child inherits a finite Linux cgroup v2 memory.max limit of 512 MiB or less; keep trusted synthetic fixture PDFs available without claiming live isolation.
On Windows, confirm process-tree cleanup only after taskkill /T /F succeeds and the daemon leader exits; otherwise report unresolved cleanup and retain the profile.
Attempt profile deletion before reporting final disposition; fail and expose the retained path when deletion returns EACCES.
notes: This JSON links the regression contract to executable tests; it is not itself an executed live capability eval. Run npm run qa:battery:test and node scripts/qa/run_battery.cjs for local fixture evidence. A full live run additionally needs a bounded Linux cgroup v2 memory.max of 512 MiB or less for safe PDF parsing.
